semanticAdvisor.summary: Requirement can be modeled as a strict fact set.

tool.description: Validate a kb_upsert payload without mutating the KB. Use this read-only preflight before kb_upsert, especially for requirements, because it returns schema/modeling errors plus semantic advisor receipts that identify prose likely needing kb_model mode requirement or predicates, ambiguity review, or an ontology-gap observation.

document.description: Optional source-first document write. Paths are workspace-relative; omit body when updating to preserve the existing body bytes (a requirement whose semantic_text changes gets the new statement in place of the old one, with its context sections kept). For a new requirement pass a sectioned body: statement, '## Context' (why, who asked, constraints), '## Source' (blockquoted excerpt and reference); context never changes the checked meaning, which stays in semantic_text.
document.x-kibi-advertised-description: Optional source document write; omit body on update to keep it. New requirements take statement, Context, Source.

plannedFacts.description: dryRun only. Fact upsert payloads (type, id, properties, optional relationships) that will be written before this payload, typically the applyPlan entries kb_model returned. They are validated in order and staged with the payload, so a requires_predicate or requires_property target that does not exist yet resolves, its claim_key is read from the plan, and the contradiction preview runs against the KB as it would be after the whole batch (result: stagedFacts, whatIf). A conflict the batch would introduce, such as an allow and a deny permission_rule on the same key, is refused as the commit would refuse it. Rejected without dryRun: write the facts first.

relationships.description: Optional relationship rows to create in the same call. For requirement encoding, prefer `constrains` + `requires_property` for strict property facts or `requires_predicate` for ontology predicate facts. Side effect: asserts edges in KB.

type.description: Relationship type enum. Use only supported values. Direction semantics follow KB model (e.g., implements symbol->req, verified_by req/scenario->test, executable_for symbol->test).
type.x-kibi-advertised-description: Relationship type, e.g. implements (symbol->req), verified_by (req/scenario->test), executable_for (symbol->test).

relationships.x-kibi-advertised-description: Optional relationship rows to create in the same call; asserts edges in the KB.

plannedFacts.x-kibi-advertised-description: dryRun only: fact payloads (e.g. kb_model applyPlan entries) staged before this one, so their links resolve.

properties.description: Entity properties to validate using the same snake_case field names accepted by kb_upsert.

workspaceRoot.description: Optional absolute path of the workspace this call is about, such as your git worktree, when it is not the server's.

tool.name: kb_validate_upsert
